To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the power tiller operated sprayers with high pressure sprays are suitable for orchard spraying.
the diameter of the orifices can be increased to 3.18 mm and the inclination of the spray guns can be increased to about 60 to 75o for better spray coverage.

the spray height of the power tiller operated, high pressure sprayer can be increased from the existing 6 m to 12 m, by varying the spray gun inclination from 0o to 90o and by increasing the orifice from 2.38 m1 to 3.18 mm.

the optimization of orifice diameter and spray angle for high pressure spray guns suitable for orchard spraying.
the design and construction of an efficient, cost effective and environment friendly sprayer.
the development of high-pressure spray guns for use in orchards, with the aim of improving the quality of the spraying and the efficiency of the application of pesticides.
